Global HIV Prevention Coalition; 2020 • Establishing community-led monitoring of HIV services — Principles

Indicators for monitoring and evaluating the response To understand how well the response is functioning and its effects, its various key requirements need to be monitored for each key population. For each of these requirements there are a number of useful indicators

Data sources Behavioural and sero-surveillance surveys. These surveys of key populations can provide prevalence data and information on the experiences, risks and service utilization of people from these groups.
